content: Root cause: The bug was caused by reading the result of the TQP (Traffic Queue Pair) statistics query from an incorrect position in the response data. The original code incorrectly accessed the data at index 4 instead of the correct index 1, leading to erroneous statistics being recorded. This misalignment was fixed by updating the index to the correct position as specified in the user manual.

Code statements:
```c
tqp->tqp_stats.rcb_rx_ring_pktnum_rcd +=
    le32_to_cpu(desc[0].data[4]);
```
```c
tqp->tqp_stats.rcb_tx_ring_pktnum_rcd +=
    le32_to_cpu(desc[0].data[4]);
```
```c
tqp->tqp_stats.rcb_rx_ring_pktnum_rcd +=
    le32_to_cpu(desc.data[4]);
```
```c
tqp->tqp_stats.rcb_tx_ring_pktnum_rcd +=
    le32_to_cpu(desc.data[4]);
```
